title: Sunday Spicy Lazy Fried Chicken
description: A delicious and easy-to-make fried chicken recipe perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. The spicy kick adds a nice twist to the classic dish.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, spicy seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Pour buttermilk into a separate shallow dish.
Dip each chicken piece into the buttermilk, coating completely, then roll in flour mixture to coat.
Place coated chicken on a plate or tray.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When oil is hot, add 2-3 chicken pieces to the skillet.
Fry chicken for about 5-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
